description: This file defines the NotificationsRepository class, which provides an interface for managing notifications within the app. It interacts with the NotificationsStore to observe notifications, mark them as read, clear notifications, and add local notifications, serving as a data layer for notifications management.

classes.name: NotificationsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing notification data, providing methods to observe, mark, clear, and add notifications.

methods.name: observeNotifications
methods.description: Returns an observable stream of notifications from the NotificationsStore.

methods.name: observeUnreadCount
methods.description: Returns an observable stream of unread notification count from the NotificationsStore.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read by its ID.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all notifications from the store.

methods.name: addLocalNotification
methods.description: Adds a local notification item to the NotificationsStore, useful in demo mode.
